cues.en: This is the Global News podcast from the BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 这里是 BBC 世界服务的《全球新闻》播客。

cues.en: I'm Jenet Khalil, and at 15 hours GMT on Monday the 28th of September, these are our main stories.
cues.zh: 我是杰内特·哈利勒。现在是格林尼治时间9月28日星期一15点，以下是主要新闻。

cues.en: The Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is reported to have flown to the UAE on Sunday for a secret meeting with its leader Mohammed bin Zayed.
cues.zh: 据报道，以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡周日飞往阿联酋，与该国领导人穆罕默德·本·扎耶德秘密会面。

cues.en: We hear how unproven rape claims led to violent demonstrations erupting at an Indian university this weekend.
cues.zh: 我们将了解，未经证实的强奸指控如何导致印度一所大学本周末爆发暴力示威。

cues.en: And we have the latest on protests in Spain sparked by the forced eviction of an 87-year-old woman from her flat.
cues.zh: 我们还将带来西班牙抗议活动的最新消息；一名87岁女子被强制逐出住所，引发了这些抗议。

cues.en: Also in this podcast, these bananas, when you cut them, if you slice them for 12 hours, they won't go brown, whereas a regular banana will.
cues.zh: 本期还将介绍一种香蕉：切开后放置12小时仍不会变褐，而普通香蕉会变褐。

cues.en: The shelf life is greatly extended. How scientists came up with a solution to help bananas stay yellow even when they're old or damaged.
cues.zh: 它的保质期大大延长。科学家想出了一种办法，让香蕉即使变老或受损也能保持黄色。

cues.en: We start this podcast with allegations that the Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu travelled secretly to the United Arab Emirates this weekend.
cues.zh: 本期首先关注有关以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡本周末秘密前往阿联酋的报道。

cues.en: This comes amid an uproar over a report by the Israeli newspaper Haaretz earlier this month that the leader of the UAE had warned Mr Netanyahu.
cues.zh: 此前，以色列报纸《国土报》本月早些时候报道称，阿联酋领导人曾警告内塔尼亚胡；这份报道引发轩然大波。

cues.en: Hamas was planning to carry out attacks just days before the 7th of October massacre that triggered the Gaza war.
cues.zh: 警告称，哈马斯计划发动袭击，而几天后就发生了触发加沙战争的10月7日大屠杀。

cues.en: With elections now just a month away, Mr Netanyahu's rivals have seized on the report as the latest example of warnings that he ignored.
cues.zh: 如今距离选举仅剩一个月，内塔尼亚胡的对手抓住这份报道，称其是他忽视警告的又一例证。

cues.en: He, for his part, has denied the Haaretz report and threatened legal action against the newspaper.
cues.zh: 而他否认《国土报》的报道，并威胁要对该报采取法律行动。

cues.en: Israeli media is reporting that his trip to the UAE over the weekend was to ask its leader Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed
cues.zh: 以色列媒体报道称，他周末前往阿联酋，是为了请其领导人谢赫·穆罕默德·本·扎耶德

cues.en: to also deny the reports that he had been warned about a looming Hamas threat.
cues.zh: 也否认自己曾收到哈马斯威胁迫近的警告。

cues.en: I got more on all this with our Middle East correspondent Yolande Knell, who's in Jerusalem.
cues.zh: 我就这些情况采访了正在耶路撒冷的中东记者约兰德·内尔。

cues.en: According to Israel's Channel 12, which broke this report, Mr Netanyahu and his entourage took a number of different private planes to make the journey to the United Arab Emirates.
cues.zh: 据首先报道此事的以色列第12频道称，内塔尼亚胡及随行人员乘坐了多架不同的私人飞机前往阿联酋。

cues.en: They stayed there for some four hours.
cues.zh: 他们在那里停留了大约4个小时。

cues.en: The aim of the visit was to have a one-on-one meeting with Mohammed bin Zayed, the Emirati president.
cues.zh: 据称，此行目的是与阿联酋总统穆罕默德·本·扎耶德举行一对一会晤。

cues.en: And this has not been confirmed by the Israeli Prime Minister's Office nor by the Emirati Foreign Ministry.
cues.zh: 以色列总理办公室和阿联酋外交部都尚未证实此事。

cues.en: But several Israeli media outlets are quoting a senior Israeli official who told them that indeed this trip did happen.
cues.zh: 但多家以色列媒体援引一名以色列高级官员的话，称这次出行确实发生过。

cues.en: And then there's that intriguing report from the Associated Press, quoting two sources who were briefed on this trip.
cues.zh: 此外，美联社还有一份引人关注的报道，援引了两名获悉此行情况的消息人士。

cues.en: It says the trip took place specifically for Mr Netanyahu to ask MBZ, as the Emirati leader is known by his initials, to deny these reports.
cues.zh: 报道说，此行专门是为了让内塔尼亚胡请求 MBZ——这位阿联酋领导人以姓名首字母为人所知——否认这些报道。

cues.en: These reports continue to circulate in Israel, saying that MBZ gave Mr Netanyahu a warning in September 2023.
cues.zh: 这些报道仍在以色列流传，称 MBZ 曾于2023年9月向内塔尼亚胡发出警告。

cues.en: That was not very long before the Hamas-led deadly attacks of the 7th of October, saying that the then leader of Hamas, Yahya Sinwar, was indeed planning a major operation.
cues.zh: 那距离哈马斯领导的10月7日致命袭击并不久；据称，当时的哈马斯领导人叶海亚·辛瓦尔确实在策划一次重大行动。

cues.en: Mr Netanyahu is reported to have responded calmly to that. The implication is that he didn't follow up on this warning.
cues.zh: 据报道，内塔尼亚胡对此平静回应。这意味着他没有跟进这项警告。

cues.en: Now he has strenuously denied that that is the case and threatened to sue the Haaretz newspaper for defamation.
cues.zh: 如今，他强烈否认情况属实，并威胁要以诽谤罪起诉《国土报》。

cues.en: We're just a month away from elections now in Israel, and this is really turning into a key issue for voters.
cues.zh: 如今距离以色列选举仅有一个月，这正成为选民关注的关键议题。

cues.en: Yes, this is a very tightly run election, and it's all happening within that context.
cues.zh: 是的，这是一场势均力敌的选举，所有事情都发生在这一背景下。

cues.en: Certainly Mr Netanyahu's political rivals, the opposition figures, have really seized on these reports.
cues.zh: 当然，内塔尼亚胡的政治对手、反对派人士抓住了这些报道大做文章。

cues.en: And there are others too suggesting that there were Arab world warnings given to Mr Netanyahu. He calls all of those an absolute lie.
cues.zh: 还有其他报道暗示，阿拉伯世界也曾向内塔尼亚胡发出警告。他称这些说法全是彻头彻尾的谎言。

cues.en: But his opponents say that it is more proof that he is unfit for office.
cues.zh: 但他的对手说，这更证明他不适合担任公职。

cues.en: Now this is really leading to more calls for a state commission of inquiry, formal investigations into who knew what and when, ahead of the 7th of October attacks.
cues.zh: 这导致要求成立国家调查委员会、正式调查谁在10月7日袭击前何时知道什么的呼声越来越高。

cues.en: And of course that just feeds into Israeli social divisions. Society has become very polarised around this issue.
cues.zh: 当然，这只会加剧以色列社会分歧。社会围绕这一问题变得高度两极化。

cues.en: And it's an extremely sensitive timing as well, just going into the 7th of October, the third anniversary of those deadly, unprecedented attacks on Israel.
cues.zh: 而现在这个时机也极其敏感：10月7日将至，那是以色列遭遇那场致命且前所未有袭击的三周年。

cues.en: Yolande Knell in Jerusalem.
cues.zh: 约兰德·内尔在耶路撒冷报道。

cues.en: Next to the Indian state of Punjab.
cues.zh: 接下来是印度旁遮普邦的消息。

cues.en: Where violent protests at a university campus broke out at the weekend.
cues.zh: 周末，一所大学校园爆发了暴力抗议。

cues.en: Over unproven claims that a female student had been raped at a hostel near the private Lovely Professional University in Phagwara.
cues.zh: 抗议源于未经证实的说法：一名女学生在菲拉瓦拉私立Lovely Professional University附近的一处宿舍遭到强奸。

cues.en: More than 2,000 police officers had to be deployed to quell the violence.
cues.zh: 警方不得不部署2000多名警员来平息暴力。

cues.en: The Director General of Police of the Punjab, Gaurav Yadav, said officers had exercised restraint.
cues.zh: 旁遮普邦警察总监高拉夫·亚达夫说，警员一直保持克制。

cues.en: And that an investigation has now been launched.
cues.zh: 他还说，调查现已展开。

cues.en: A very conscious decision was taken not to use force on these students.
cues.zh: 当局经过慎重决定，没有对这些学生使用武力。

cues.en: And since there were grievances against the university administration, efforts were made to sort out the grievances through discussions.
cues.zh: 由于学生对大学管理方有不满，当局努力通过协商解决这些问题。

cues.en: I asked our South Asia correspondent Azadeh Miri what was known about the claims that sparked the protests.
cues.zh: 我询问了本台南亚记者Azadeh Miri，了解引发抗议的那些说法目前已知的情况。

cues.en: Most of the information that's been circulating has been on social media, and I spoke to police earlier, and there's still a lot that has been unproven.
cues.zh: 流传的大部分信息来自社交媒体。我早些时候采访了警方，目前仍有许多内容未经证实。

cues.en: Right now, they are still waiting to identify who the alleged victim would be.
cues.zh: 目前，他们仍在等待确认所谓受害者的身份。

cues.en: Students are the ones who have come to the police, urging for a criminal complaint.
cues.zh: 是学生来到警方那里，要求提交刑事投诉。

cues.en: A police report to be filed, but they weren't able to provide a name for the alleged victim.
cues.zh: 他们要求立案，但无法提供所谓受害者的姓名。

cues.en: Police have also reviewed CCTV footage throughout the week.
cues.zh: 警方还查看了整周的闭路电视录像。

cues.en: So far, they haven't been able to identify any non-students entering the hostel.
cues.zh: 截至目前，他们无法确认有任何非学生进入过这处宿舍。

cues.en: And so there's a lot that is very unclear.
cues.zh: 因此，仍有很多情况非常不明朗。

cues.en: What is obvious, though, is that this is an issue that has ignited so much anger.
cues.zh: 但显而易见的是，这一问题激起了极大愤怒。

cues.en: In Punjab, in Phagwara, and not just there.
cues.zh: 地点就在旁遮普的菲拉瓦拉，而且不只那里如此。

cues.en: There have been a string of sexual assaults in Delhi, here in the capital, as well as across India that have made headlines.
cues.zh: 德里这座首都，以及印度各地，接连发生过登上头条的性侵事件。

cues.en: And it is why this has tapped into a sentiment.
cues.zh: 也正因此，这件事触动了一种情绪。

cues.en: Here, where women and students broadly feel that it isn't always safe on their campuses.
cues.zh: 这里的女性和学生普遍觉得，校园并不总是安全。

cues.en: And they want the authorities to do more.
cues.zh: 他们希望当局采取更多行动。

cues.en: It is also worth saying that the university itself is insisting that these are misleading rumors.
cues.zh: 还应指出，大学方面坚称这些是误导性的传言。

cues.en: False allegations, and they believe, they're alleging, that it's part of a campaign to tarnish their reputation.
cues.zh: 校方称这是虚假指控，并认为——他们声称——这是损害其声誉的一场行动。

cues.en: The police have told us that they have formed this special investigation team.
cues.zh: 警方告诉我们，他们已经成立了这个特别调查组。

cues.en: To look into these matters, given students are demanding some action here.
cues.zh: 以调查这些问题，因为学生正在要求当局采取行动。

cues.en: The police had to deploy a huge number of officers, some 2,000 officers, to try to calm the situation down.
cues.zh: 警方不得不部署大量警员，约有2000人，试图平息局势。

cues.en: Just tell us about what happened over the weekend because it did get very violent.
cues.zh: 请告诉我们周末发生了什么，因为局势确实变得非常暴力。

cues.en: It was days after the allegations had surfaced that these protests erupted.
cues.zh: 这些指控出现数日后，抗议爆发了。

cues.en: Students and student representatives at LPU were saying that this is because the university wasn't taking any action.
cues.zh: LPU的学生和学生代表说，这是因为大学没有采取任何行动。

cues.en: What happened, though, is that university property was damaged, vandalized.
cues.zh: 然而，大学的财产遭到损坏和破坏。

cues.en: They lit fires, they even blocked a major highway in Punjab in Phagwara.
cues.zh: 他们点火，甚至堵塞了旁遮普菲拉瓦拉的一条主要公路。

cues.en: And so yes, police at that point had held several meetings with student representatives to try and calm the situation down.
cues.zh: 所以，当时警方确实与学生代表举行了多次会议，试图平息局势。

cues.en: The university has now suspended classes for ten days.
cues.zh: 大学现已停课十天。

cues.en: Many students have gone home according to police, and that's why the situation is very much under control.
cues.zh: 警方称，许多学生已经回家，因此局势已基本得到控制。

cues.en: And police haven't been deployed because they're not expecting any further protests today.
cues.zh: 警方没有部署警力，因为他们预计今天不会再有抗议。

cues.en: But separately, you have seen multiple protests here in the capital.
cues.zh: 不过，另一方面，你也看到首都这里发生了多场抗议。

cues.en: Because, again, there has been a string of cases like this and it's not new to India.
cues.zh: 因为正如我们所说，印度接连发生过类似案件，这并不是新现象。

cues.en: But the fact that they're making headlines and the fact that students are now saying enough is enough.
cues.zh: 但这些案件登上头条，而且学生现在说“够了”，这一事实意味着——

cues.en: It means that people are coming out on the streets to demand more action here.
cues.zh: 人们正走上街头，要求这里采取更多行动。

cues.en: Azadeh Miri in Delhi.
cues.zh: 德里的Azadeh Miri报道。

cues.en: Images of a frail elderly woman in Madrid being evicted from an apartment that she'd lived in for decades
cues.zh: 一名体弱的老妇在马德里被驱逐：她在这套公寓里住了数十年

cues.en: on a stretcher have sparked widespread indignation across Spain.
cues.zh: 她被担架抬走的画面激起了西班牙各地的广泛愤怒。

cues.en: Tens of thousands of people marched through Spain's capital on Saturday, rattling keys as they called for measures to curb housing costs.
cues.zh: 周六，数万人走过西班牙首都，摇响钥匙，要求采取措施遏制住房成本。

cues.en: Some of them brought tents and sleeping bags and have now set up a protest camp in the city centre.
cues.zh: 一些人带来帐篷和睡袋，如今已在市中心搭起抗议营地。

cues.en: Eighty-seven-year-old Mari Carmen Abascal had benefited from a very low rent thanks to rent control.
cues.zh: 87岁的玛丽·卡门·阿瓦斯卡尔因租金管制，一直享有很低的租金。

cues.en: But she couldn't afford a higher rate when her home was bought by an investment fund.
cues.zh: 但她的住所被投资基金买下后，便负担不起更高的租金。

cues.en: Her case has highlighted the growing problem of soaring rents and housing shortages, partly because of investors
cues.zh: 她的遭遇凸显了租金飙升和住房短缺日益严重的问题，部分原因在于投资者

cues.en: and the popularity of short-term holiday rental businesses like Airbnb.
cues.zh: 以及 Airbnb 等短期度假租赁业务的流行。

cues.en: Our correspondent Guy Hedgecoe was at the camp.
cues.zh: 我们的记者盖伊·赫奇科在抗议营地。

cues.en: He told Krupa Padhy about the protest.
cues.zh: 他向克鲁帕·帕迪介绍了这场抗议。

cues.en: I am in Puerta del Sol in central Madrid, right next to the protest camp.
cues.zh: 我在马德里市中心的太阳门广场，就在抗议营地旁边。

cues.en: There are, I suppose, around two or 300 tents right in front of me
cues.zh: 我面前大概有两三百顶帐篷

cues.en: where people have been spending the last few nights
cues.zh: 人们已经在这里度过了最近几个夜晚

cues.en: As part of this protest, they got banners hanging up demanding measures from politicians to try and deal with this crisis.
cues.zh: 作为抗议的一部分，他们挂起横幅，要求政治人士采取措施应对这场危机。

cues.en: And they are here, they say, because they want to pressure the government
cues.zh: 他们说，来到这里是为了向政府施压

cues.en: the central government, the local government and the political class in general
cues.zh: 包括中央政府、地方政府以及整个政治阶层

cues.en: to take drastic measures to try and deal with this crisis, this housing crisis
cues.zh: 要求它们采取激进措施，解决这场住房危机

cues.en: which has seen rentals soar over the last few years.
cues.zh: 过去几年，租金在这场危机中一路飙升。

cues.en: Most of these people, the vast majority, are young people, and it's young people above all who are affected by this crisis.
cues.zh: 这里绝大多数人都是年轻人，而受这场危机影响最大的正是年轻人。

cues.en: You spoke about rental prices there. I imagine that's one of many concerns when it comes to the housing challenge there in Spain.
cues.zh: 你提到了那里的租金。我想，租金只是西班牙住房挑战带来的诸多问题之一。

cues.en: Yes, I mean the main one is rentals and the fact that it's so difficult to find an affordable home to rent
cues.zh: 是的，主要问题是租金，以及很难找到负担得起的出租住房

cues.en: certainly in the big cities, whether it's Madrid, Barcelona or Valencia
cues.zh: 尤其是在大城市，无论是马德里、巴塞罗那还是瓦伦西亚

cues.en: but really across the country rentals have increased so much.
cues.zh: 但实际上，全国各地的租金都大幅上涨。

cues.en: It's very difficult to find an affordable place to live.
cues.zh: 现在很难找到住得起的地方。

cues.en: That affects young people, but it affects people across the board as well.
cues.zh: 这影响年轻人，也影响各个年龄层的人。

cues.en: The big concern is that not enough homes are being built.
cues.zh: 人们最担心的是，建造的住房不够。

cues.en: That's what many people see as the cause.
cues.zh: 许多人认为这就是问题的原因。

cues.en: But a lot of these protesters believe that there is housing that should be available
cues.zh: 但许多抗议者认为，有些住房本应可以提供

cues.en: but it's being used for other things, whether it's Airbnb accommodation for tourists
cues.zh: 却被用于其他用途，比如给游客住的 Airbnb 房源

cues.en: or it's property which has been
cues.zh: 或者，有些房产已经

cues.en: bought by investment companies and it's being used as an investment rather than being made available
cues.zh: 被投资公司买下，用作投资，而不是拿出来

cues.en: to rent out to ordinary people.
cues.zh: 出租给普通人。

cues.en: You mentioned that this is particularly impacting young people, but of course it was the case of
cues.zh: 你提到这尤其影响年轻人，但当然，正是这起事件

cues.en: Mari Carmen Abascal that brought us to this point where people decided to take to the streets.
cues.zh: 玛丽·卡门·阿瓦斯卡尔的遭遇，让人们走上街头，形成了今天的局面。

cues.en: So I imagine the elderly are equally as impacted or somewhat, but what does that say more broadly about the extent of the crisis?
cues.zh: 所以我想，老年人或多或少也受到影响。这更广泛地说明了这场危机有多严重？

cues.en: Well, it's something which has been brewing for some years now.
cues.zh: 这其实是酝酿了数年的问题。

cues.en: People have been complaining about the housing crisis.
cues.zh: 人们一直在抱怨住房危机。

cues.en: Last year we saw some big demonstrations on the streets of cities like Madrid, other cities across the country.
cues.zh: 去年，马德里等城市以及全国其他城市的街头都举行了大型示威。

cues.en: But it seems to be coming to a head now.
cues.zh: 但现在看来，问题正走向爆发。

cues.en: There does seem to be the Mari Carmen Abascal eviction seems to have become a sort of symbol.
cues.zh: 玛丽·卡门·阿瓦斯卡尔被驱逐一事，似乎已经成了一种象征。

cues.en: There are photos of Mari Carmen sort of pinned up here at the protest camp because these people here see her as a symbol
cues.zh: 抗议营地里贴着玛丽·卡门的照片，因为这里的人把她视为一种象征

cues.en: which they hope is going to bring about this sort of broader change and is going to pressure politicians.
cues.zh: 他们希望这能带来更广泛的改变，并向政治人士施压。

cues.en: So it affects everyone. And there is a feeling that this could be a crucial moment
cues.zh: 所以这影响每个人。人们感觉，这可能是一个关键时刻

cues.en: when it comes to bringing about some kind of change when it comes to the housing market in Spain.
cues.zh: 可能推动西班牙住房市场发生某种变化。

cues.en: How is Mari Carmen doing? Do we have any insights?
cues.zh: 玛丽·卡门现在怎么样？我们知道她的情况吗？

cues.en: The last we heard was that she had been taken to hospital after she was evicted.
cues.zh: 我们最近得知，她被驱逐后被送往医院。

cues.en: She does have a disability.
cues.zh: 她身患残疾。

cues.en: When she left hospital, she was in a wheelchair and then taken on a stretcher straight to hospital here in Madrid.
cues.zh: 她离开医院时坐着轮椅，随后又被担架直接送往马德里的医院。

cues.en: And then we're told that from hospital we believe that she is—her health is okay.
cues.zh: 我们得知，她从医院出来后，健康状况应该还好。

cues.en: Once she leaves hospital, she will go and stay with relatives.
cues.zh: 她离开医院后会去和亲属住在一起。

cues.en: There has been some talk of the investment company that evicted her backtracking
cues.zh: 有消息称，驱逐她的投资公司正在改变态度

cues.en: and trying to see if it can allow her to go back into the property.
cues.zh: 并试图让她回到那处房产。

cues.en: That looks like it's unlikely.
cues.zh: 但这似乎不太可能。

cues.en: What we know at the moment is she's probably going to go and stay with relatives
cues.zh: 目前我们知道的是，她可能会去和亲属住在一起

cues.en: at least in the short term.
cues.zh: 至少短期内如此。

cues.en: Guy Hedgecoe in Madrid.
cues.zh: 马德里的盖伊·赫奇科报道。

cues.en: Now, if you love bananas, we have some good news for you.
cues.zh: 如果你喜欢香蕉，现在有个好消息告诉你。

cues.en: Scientists here in England have developed a gene-edited version of bananas that will stay nice and yellow
cues.zh: 英国科学家研发出一种基因编辑香蕉，能保持鲜黄色，

cues.en: even if they get old or damaged.
cues.zh: 即使香蕉变老或受损。

cues.en: It's now had the final approval to be sold on British supermarket shelves.
cues.zh: 它如今已获得最终批准，可以在英国超市货架上销售。

cues.en: Professor Jonathan Jones from the Sainsbury Laboratory in Norwich is involved in the development.
cues.zh: 诺里奇桑斯伯里实验室的乔纳森·琼斯教授参与了这项研发。

cues.en: It's been done by a company in Norwich called Tropic Biosciences,
cues.zh: 这项工作由诺里奇一家名为 Tropic Biosciences 的公司完成。

cues.en: and what they've done is to work based on the knowledge of many scores of years
cues.zh: 他们的工作建立在数十年来积累的知识之上，

cues.en: of thousands of researchers, which tells us a lot about what the genes in plants do.
cues.zh: 这些知识来自数千名研究人员，让我们了解植物基因的作用。

cues.en: Every plant has 25 to 40,000 genes or more,
cues.zh: 每种植物都有两万五千到四万个甚至更多的基因，

cues.en: and they know the genes that make bananas or potatoes or apples go brown when they've been cut.
cues.zh: 研究人员知道，香蕉、土豆或苹果切开后变褐，是由哪些基因造成的。

cues.en: And there's a particular gene called polyphenol oxidase,
cues.zh: 其中有一个特定基因叫多酚氧化酶，

cues.en: and what they've done is to reduce the expression of that one gene without affecting any other genes,
cues.zh: 他们降低了这个基因的表达，同时不影响其他任何基因，

cues.en: with the result that the browning process is either completely abolished or much, much slower.
cues.zh: 结果是，变褐过程要么完全消失，要么大大减慢。

cues.en: So I don't think you'll actually necessarily change the flavour.
cues.zh: 所以我认为它实际上不一定会改变味道。

cues.en: It will be softer.
cues.zh: 它会更柔软。

cues.en: I mean, of course, the unripe banana is much firmer.
cues.zh: 当然，我的意思是，未成熟的香蕉要硬得多。

cues.en: The wider point in all of this is to try and reduce food waste,
cues.zh: 这一切更广泛的意义，在于努力减少食物浪费，

cues.en: which remains a huge, huge issue.
cues.zh: 这是一个仍然非常严重的问题。

cues.en: That's exactly right. Food waste is between 10 and 30% in the world of bananas.
cues.zh: 完全正确。香蕉产业中的食物浪费率在10%到30%之间。

cues.en: These bananas, when you cut them, if you slice them for 12 hours, they won't go brown, whereas a regular banana will.
cues.zh: 这些香蕉切片后放置12小时也不会变褐，而普通香蕉会变褐。

cues.en: The shelf life is greatly extended,
cues.zh: 保质期大大延长，

cues.en: and also it opens up new food service products. So you can make concoctions of many different sliced fruits,
cues.zh: 还会带来新的餐饮产品。这样就能把许多不同的切片水果调配在一起，

cues.en: and if you put the bananas in, normally they'll go brown and you'll have to discard it
cues.zh: 如果加入普通香蕉，它们通常会变褐，你只好把它扔掉，

cues.en: because people won't want to buy it, but it'll actually persist in an edible-looking state for much longer.
cues.zh: 因为人们不愿购买；但这种香蕉能以看起来可食用的状态维持更久。

cues.en: Professor Jonathan Jones speaking to Anna Foster.
cues.zh: 乔纳森·琼斯教授接受安娜·福斯特采访。

cues.en: Still to come in this podcast, 20 years after they burst onto the music scene and helped turn
cues.zh: 本期节目稍后：他们闯入音乐圈已有20年，并帮助把

cues.en: K-pop into a global phenomenon,
cues.zh: K-pop 变成全球现象，

cues.en: I'm not going to say the kings of K-pop; they're beyond that.
cues.zh: 我不称他们为 K-pop 之王，因为他们超越了这个称号。

cues.en: I think they're like the emperors of K-pop. Anything that you think of in K-pop, they did it first.
cues.zh: 我觉得他们就像 K-pop 的皇帝。你能想到的任何 K-pop 元素，都是他们最先做到的。

cues.en: The South Korean boy band BIGBANG return to London.
cues.zh: 韩国男子组合 BIGBANG 回到伦敦。

cues.en: The whole of Bangkok has been declared a flood disaster zone after two days of torrential rain inundated much of the Thai capital,
cues.zh: 连日暴雨淹没泰国首都大部分地区后，整个曼谷被宣布为洪灾区，

cues.en: blocking roads and submerging vehicles.
cues.zh: 道路被堵，车辆被淹。

cues.en: People have been urged to stay at home and those living close to the city's network of canals have been advised to move their belongings to upper floors.
cues.zh: 当局敦促民众留在家中，并建议住在城市运河网络附近的人把财物搬到高层。

cues.en: Jonathan Head gave us this update from Bangkok.
cues.zh: 乔纳森·赫德从曼谷带来最新情况。

cues.en: The good news is that the rain has stopped.
cues.zh: 好消息是，雨已经停了。

cues.en: I mean, we had more or less three days of almost uninterrupted rain.
cues.zh: 我的意思是，我们差不多连续下了三天雨。

cues.en: That's exceptional. It's the monsoon season.
cues.zh: 这很不寻常。现在是季风季节。

cues.en: You expect heavy thunderstorms at this time of year, but they normally last an hour or two.
cues.zh: 每年这个时候会有强雷暴，但通常只持续一两个小时。

cues.en: Having persistent rain over such a long period of time has simply put too much water onto the roads
cues.zh: 长时间持续降雨，让太多积水流到道路上，

cues.en: for the city's canals and its pumps to deal with.
cues.zh: 城市的运河和水泵根本应付不了。

cues.en: Now, Bangkok's a very low-lying city. It's on average only about a metre and a half above sea level.
cues.zh: 曼谷是一座地势很低的城市，平均只比海平面高约一米半。

cues.en: It's quite close to the sea.
cues.zh: 它离海也很近。

cues.en: And when you get that much water, it just can't get pushed out to sea fast enough.
cues.zh: 而水量这么大时，积水根本无法足够快地排入大海。

cues.en: And because there hasn't been rain over the last 12 hours or so, water levels have gone down in the city.
cues.zh: 由于过去大约12小时没有下雨，城里的水位已经下降。

cues.en: Actually, most of the water that covered the roads has gone, but in outlying areas of Bangkok,
cues.zh: 实际上，覆盖道路的大部分积水已经退去，但在曼谷外围地区，

cues.en: there are still areas with at least half a metre of water.
cues.zh: 仍有些地方积水至少半米深。

cues.en: That means vehicles can't get in. There are still thousands of residents, particularly in certain housing estates, completely cut off.
cues.zh: 这意味着车辆无法进入。一些住宅区仍有数千名居民与外界完全隔绝。

cues.en: Their power is out as well.
cues.zh: 他们那里也停电了。

cues.en: And the priority today for the Bangkok authorities is to find ways to get more assistance, food and water, basically, into them,
cues.zh: 曼谷当局今天的首要任务，是想办法把更多援助、食物和饮用水送进这些地区，

cues.en: to bring out anybody with acute medical needs and just keep pumping that water.
cues.zh: 救出有紧急医疗需求的人，并继续抽排积水。

cues.en: Because this low-pressure system, which produced such huge volumes of rain, has now moved on.
cues.zh: 因为带来如此大量降雨的低压系统已经移走。

cues.en: They're hopeful. The meteorological department says they're not expecting this kind of heavy rain for the rest of this week,
cues.zh: 气象部门表示，本周剩余时间预计不会再有这样的暴雨，他们对此抱有希望，

cues.en: and that should give enough time for the water that's been covering these low-lying areas to be moved out.
cues.zh: 这应能留出足够时间，排走覆盖这些低洼地区的积水。

cues.en: But it is a warning for Bangkok and people living here about how vulnerable they are to heavy rain.
cues.zh: 但这也警告曼谷及当地居民，他们很容易受到暴雨影响。

cues.en: And of course, I mean, we don't know what caused this particular bout of rain, but weather has become a lot more unpredictable.
cues.zh: 当然，我的意思是，我们不知道这场降雨具体由何引起，但天气已经变得难以预测得多。

cues.en: And so it's something the authorities are going to have to factor in the future. Jonathan Head.
cues.zh: 因此，这是当局今后必须纳入考虑的因素。乔纳森·赫德。

cues.en: South Korea is demanding that Ukraine apologises after President Zelensky's surprise announcement at the UN that he had sent two captured North Korean soldiers to South Korea.
cues.zh: 韩国要求乌克兰道歉，此前泽连斯基总统突然在联合国宣布，他已将两名被俘的朝鲜士兵送往韩国。

cues.en: Seoul says the transfer was supposed to remain a secret to protect the soldiers' families, who are still in the North, from possible punishment.
cues.zh: 首尔方面称，这次转移原本应当保密，以保护仍在朝鲜的这些士兵家人免遭可能的惩罚。

cues.en: Our Seoul correspondent Jake Kwon explains.
cues.zh: 我们的首尔记者杰克·权为你解释。

cues.en: The two North Korean soldiers were told by Pyongyang to kill themselves when facing capture.
cues.zh: 这两名朝鲜士兵被平壤告知，面临被俘时要自杀。

cues.en: Their survival meant they can no longer go home.
cues.zh: 他们活了下来，也就再也无法回家。

cues.en: Last week, after a lengthy negotiation between Seoul and Kyiv, the two soldiers were finally transferred in secret.
cues.zh: 上周，首尔与基辅经过漫长谈判后，这两名士兵终于被秘密转移。

cues.en: When it was revealed by Mr Zelensky, South Korea cried foul, saying Ukraine broke the promise of secrecy, seriously damaging trust and friendship.
cues.zh: 泽连斯基先生披露此事后，韩国指责乌克兰违反保密承诺，严重损害了信任与友谊。

cues.en: Ukraine disputes there was any agreement. South Korea has been a quiet supporter of Ukraine.
cues.zh: 乌克兰否认双方曾达成任何协议。韩国一直是乌克兰低调的支持者。

cues.en: Earlier, South Korea pledged 100 million dollars' worth of assistance; at the same time, it has been trying to reopen peace negotiations with Pyongyang.
cues.zh: 韩国此前承诺提供价值1亿美元的援助，同时一直试图与平壤重启和平谈判。

cues.en: Jake Kwon in Seoul.
cues.zh: 首尔记者杰克·权报道。

cues.en: Uganda's Chief of Defence Forces General Muhoozi Kainerugaba, who is also the son of President Yoweri Museveni
cues.zh: 乌干达国防军司令穆胡齐·卡伊内鲁加巴将军，也是总统约韦里·穆塞韦尼的儿子

cues.en: has said all government ministers must obtain his permission before travelling abroad.
cues.zh: 表示所有政府部长出国前都必须获得他的许可。

cues.en: He made the announcement after questioning the country's Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, Haruna Kasolo.
cues.zh: 他是在质问该国外交国务部长哈鲁纳·卡索洛之后宣布这一要求的。

cues.en: Some in Uganda see the official diplomatic visit to Turkey as the latest example of the general's growing political influence.
cues.zh: 这起因一次赴土耳其的正式外交访问而起的事件，被乌干达一些人视为这位将军政治影响力日益扩大的最新例证。

cues.en: So what's the reaction been? Political and security analyst Angelo Izama has been speaking to Krupa Padhy.
cues.zh: 那么反应如何？政治与安全分析人士安杰洛·伊扎马接受了克鲁帕·帕迪的采访。

cues.en: I would say there's a muted reaction, mainly because these kinds of interventions by Chief of Defence Forces General Muhoozi are becoming his trademark.
cues.zh: 我认为反应较为低调，主要是因为国防军司令穆胡齐将军的这类干预举动正逐渐成为他的标志。

cues.en: He has in the past intervened in ways that many people consider unorthodox.
cues.zh: 他过去曾以许多人认为不合常规的方式进行干预。

cues.en: And the latest intervention is one in a long list of, certainly, out-of-the-box interventions in Uganda's political life.
cues.zh: 这次干预是他一长串、显然颇为出格的干预之一，发生在乌干达政治生活中。

cues.en: And when you say muted, is that because this statement isn't being taken seriously?
cues.zh: 你说反应低调，是因为这番言论没有被认真对待吗？

cues.en: And that it will have no impact, that government ministers will not seek his permission before travelling abroad?
cues.zh: 也就是说它不会产生影响，政府部长出国前不会征求他的许可？

cues.en: Not at all. It will certainly have impact, and the reason for that is his status as Chief of Defence Forces.
cues.zh: 完全不是。它肯定会产生影响，原因在于他国防军司令的身份。

cues.en: But outside of the administration of government, he is now considered, perhaps unofficially, as one of the main political forces in the country.
cues.zh: 不过在政府行政体系之外，他如今或许非正式地被视为该国主要政治力量之一。

cues.en: His Patriotic League of Uganda, which is a loose political movement, is consolidating, at least in the minds of the public.
cues.zh: 他的乌干达爱国联盟是一个松散的政治运动，至少在公众心目中正逐渐巩固。

cues.en: They certainly seem to have the upper hand in terms of initiating widespread popular political activities, such as public war on corruption, which is very popular right now.
cues.zh: 就发起广泛的民众政治活动而言，他们似乎确实占据上风，例如公开反腐，而这在当下很受欢迎。

cues.en: One of his main supporters is the local government minister, who has been in the countryside running a very popular anti-corruption campaign.
cues.zh: 他的主要支持者之一是地方政府部长，此人一直在乡间开展广受欢迎的反腐败运动。

cues.en: I think the political moment is in his favour.
cues.zh: 我认为当前的政治形势对他有利。

cues.en: And so, in many ways, it sounds like he's already acting like a de facto president there.
cues.zh: 所以在很多方面看来，他已经在扮演事实上的总统。

cues.en: Yes, and you know, to be fair to this issue of ministerial travel, it has been lingering around for a long time.
cues.zh: 是的，不过公平地说，部长出行这个问题已经存在很久了。

cues.en: I think there was an order by his father, President Yoweri Museveni, asking ministers to reduce their travel around COVID.
cues.zh: 我认为他的父亲、总统约韦里·穆塞韦尼曾下令，要求部长们减少新冠疫情期间的出行。

cues.en: Travel by government ministers and department heads has been generally frowned upon
cues.zh: 政府部长和部门负责人出行通常不受欢迎，

cues.en: because it's a sense that it's not very, you know, a good way to spend scarce resources.
cues.zh: 因为人们觉得，把稀缺资源花在这上面并不是很好的做法。

cues.en: So I think the muted reaction could be, well, you know, the cabinet is very big.
cues.zh: 所以我认为反应低调可能是因为，内阁规模很大。

cues.en: Cost of public administration is equally large.
cues.zh: 公共行政的成本同样很高。

cues.en: General Muhoozi has been online arguing against wasteful spending and corruption, and so many people might just shrug their shoulders.
cues.zh: 穆胡齐将军一直在网上反对浪费性支出和腐败，因此许多人可能只是耸耸肩。

cues.en: and say, well, why should ministers burn scarce resources in the air?
cues.zh: 然后说，那么，部长们为什么要把稀缺资源耗费在空中旅行上？

cues.en: Interestingly, earlier in the year he also tried to take on the media as well there in Uganda.
cues.zh: 有趣的是，今年早些时候，他还试图在乌干达对媒体出手。

cues.en: Quite true. The media body that I worked for for very many years, Nation Media Group, was shut down for several weeks.
cues.zh: 确实如此。我曾工作多年的媒体机构——Nation Media Group，曾被关闭数周。

cues.en: But my understanding is that this is something that had been brewing prior to the election because of frosty relations in the nature of the reporting
cues.zh: 但据我了解，这件事在选举前就已酝酿了一段时间，原因是双方在报道性质问题上的关系冷淡，

cues.en: and that it was actually the complaints by his dad, the president, that eventually reached that point.
cues.zh: 实际上是他父亲、总统提出的抱怨，最终导致事情发展到那一步。

cues.en: Political and security analyst Angelo Izama.
cues.zh: 政治与安全分析人士安杰洛·伊扎马。

cues.en: One of the South Korean boy bands that helped make K-pop a fixture of stadiums all over the world is Big Bang.
cues.zh: Big Bang是帮助K-pop成为全球体育场常客的韩国男团之一。

cues.en: So much so that they've been dubbed the kings of K-pop.
cues.zh: 他们甚至被称为K-pop之王。

cues.en: Now, 20 years after their debut album and 14 years after their first show in London, Big Bang have returned to the British capital.
cues.zh: 如今，在首张专辑发行20年、首次在伦敦演出14年后，Big Bang回到了英国首都。

cues.en: Gigi Ahn went to their show.
cues.zh: Gigi Ahn前往现场观看了演出。

cues.en: These were a few of the fans outside Tottenham Hotspur Stadium in North London singing along to one of the South Korean band's favourite tracks.
cues.zh: 这些是北伦敦托特纳姆热刺球场外、跟唱这支韩国乐队热门歌曲的少数歌迷。

cues.en: Later, their voices joined a sea of thousands inside the venue, who held the group's trademark yellow crown light sticks.
cues.zh: 后来，场内成千上万的人汇成歌声的海洋，手中挥舞着该团标志性的黄色皇冠荧光棒。

cues.en: Fourteen years after Big Bang first came to London, the K-pop pioneers were back.
cues.zh: Big Bang首次来到伦敦14年后，这些K-pop先驱回来了。

cues.en: This time they were playing a stadium, and for fans here, this was more than just a concert.
cues.zh: 这一次他们在体育场演出，对这里的歌迷而言，这不只是一场演唱会。

cues.en: I won't call them the kings of K-pop; I think they're beyond that.
cues.zh: 我不称他们为K-pop之王；我认为他们超越了这个称号。

cues.en: I think they're like the emperors of K-pop.
cues.zh: 我觉得他们更像是K-pop的皇帝。

cues.en: They are anything that you think of for K-pop, they did it first.
cues.zh: 凡是你能想到的K-pop形式，他们都是最先做到的。

cues.en: Big Bang formed 20 years ago, but to understand why this return to London matters, you have to go back to 2012.
cues.zh: Big Bang成立于20年前，但要理解这次回到伦敦为何重要，就得回到2012年。

cues.en: Dr Haekyung Um, who researches Korean popular music at the University of Liverpool, was also at that Wembley show.
cues.zh: 研究韩国流行音乐的利物浦大学严惠京博士也参加了那场温布利演出。

cues.en: There were a couple of K-pop performances in London,
cues.zh: 当时伦敦有几场K-pop演出，

cues.en: but they were more like a collection of different acts performing just a highlight of one or two pieces.
cues.zh: 但更像不同艺人的合集，每人只表演一两首歌中的精彩片段。

cues.en: But as far as I know, it was probably one of the first, if not the first.
cues.zh: 但据我所知，这可能是最早的一场，如果不是最早的话。

cues.en: At that show, they gave a full performance in a venue such as the Wembley Arena.
cues.zh: 在那场演出中，他们在温布利体育馆这样的场地完成了整场表演。

cues.en: At the time, K-pop was still far less established in Europe.
cues.zh: 当时，K-pop在欧洲的基础仍远未稳固。

cues.en: Big Bang were among the early Korean acts to bring a full-scale show to a major European venue.
cues.zh: Big Bang是较早把完整演出带到欧洲大型场馆的韩国艺人之一。

cues.en: And crucially, they showed the industry that there was an audience here.
cues.zh: 更重要的是，他们向业界证明这里有观众。

cues.en: Dr Um says their success sent a signal to other K-pop acts that Europe was a viable market.
cues.zh: 严博士说，他们的成功向其他K-pop艺人发出信号：欧洲是一个可行的市场。

cues.en: Ever since the Big Bang concert, many, many different acts have chosen to come to Europe, or especially London.
cues.zh: 自Big Bang那场演唱会以来，许多不同的艺人选择来到欧洲，尤其是伦敦。

cues.en: Because before then I don't think they dared to think about it.
cues.zh: 因为在那之前，我不认为他们敢这样想。

cues.en: BTS debuted in 2013.
cues.zh: BTS于2013年出道。

cues.en: We're talking about the pre-BTS era, so it really set the kind of template for a successful K-pop act in many ways.
cues.zh: 我们说的是BTS之前的时代，所以在很多方面，这确实为成功的K-pop艺人树立了范本。

cues.en: Since then, K-pop has grown from a niche genre in the West into a global live phenomenon.
cues.zh: 从那以后，K-pop从西方的小众音乐类型发展成全球性的现场文化现象。

cues.en: But Big Bang's audience hasn't simply disappeared with the arrival of newer generations.
cues.zh: 但随着新一代艺人出现，Big Bang的观众并没有就此消失。

cues.en: Fans were still travelling to London specifically for their return.
cues.zh: 歌迷们仍专程前往伦敦，迎接他们回归。

cues.en: I did fly all the way from Poland to be here.
cues.zh: 我确实一路从波兰飞到这里。

cues.en: And there are now fans who weren't even around when Big Bang first played London.
cues.zh: 现在还有一些歌迷，在Big Bang首次来到伦敦时甚至还没出生。

cues.en: Some discovered them through T.O.P.'s role in Squid Game,
cues.zh: 有些人是通过T.O.P.在《鱿鱼游戏》中的角色认识他们的，

cues.en: others through TikTok or friends and family who were longtime listeners.
cues.zh: 另一些人则通过TikTok，或通过一直听他们歌的亲友认识他们。

cues.en: For older fans, though, Big Bang represents something different: a period when being a K-pop fan in the West was still far from being commonplace.
cues.zh: 但对年长歌迷来说，Big Bang代表着另一段时期：那时在西方成为K-pop歌迷还远未普遍。

cues.en: Big Bang means nostalgia to me.
cues.zh: Big Bang对我来说意味着怀旧。

cues.en: Before all of this, it was not cool to like K-pop, but now it's all over mainstream, so the OGs know it.
cues.zh: 在这一切发生前，喜欢K-pop并不时髦；但现在它已进入主流，所以老粉丝都明白。

cues.en: And the group themselves have changed almost as much as the industry around them.
cues.zh: 而这个组合本身的变化，几乎和周围的行业一样大。

cues.en: Big Bang went from five members to three amid military service, departures and controversy, while the remaining members pursued solo careers.
cues.zh: Big Bang经历服兵役、成员离队和争议，从五人变成三人，其余成员则发展个人事业。

cues.en: For years, there was no guarantee they would return as a group at all.
cues.zh: 多年来，没有人能保证他们还会以组合形式回归。

cues.en: But 20 years after their debut, they are still capable of bringing fans from around the world together.
cues.zh: 但出道20年后，他们仍能把世界各地的歌迷聚到一起。

cues.en: The success of this world tour in 2026 to mark the 20th anniversary is going to be real proof that they are skilled and at the top of the game.
cues.zh: 这场纪念出道20周年的2026年世界巡演若成功，将真正证明他们技艺精湛、仍处于行业顶尖。

cues.en: And member Taeyang was clearly pleased to be back.
cues.zh: 成员Taeyang显然很高兴回到这里。

cues.en: London is the best crowd.
cues.zh: 伦敦的观众是最棒的。

cues.en: Their return is a reminder of just how much the K-pop landscape has changed.
cues.zh: 他们的回归提醒人们，K-pop的格局已经发生了多大变化。

cues.en: They came to Europe at a time when few K-pop acts were willing to take that step, and their success helped open the door for others.
cues.zh: 他们来到欧洲时，很少有K-pop艺人愿意迈出这一步；他们的成功为后来者打开了大门。

cues.en: And now they're back, this time as veterans of a global K-pop industry they helped to shape.
cues.zh: 如今他们回来了，这一次，他们已是自己参与塑造的全球K-pop产业的元老。

cues.en: Gigi Ahn with that report.
cues.zh: 以上是Gigi Ahn的报道。

cues.en: And that's all from us for now.
cues.zh: 我们暂时就说到这里。

cues.zh: 如果你想联系我们，可以发送邮件至globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk。

cues.zh: 你现在也可以观看我们的完整节目；只需在YouTube搜索Global News Podcast。

cues.zh: 我是Janat Jalil。
